description: Create an email campaign; it starts paused. Free. For emails and recipients you bring yourself; to have Deeplead find the recipients and draft the emails, launch an idea with campaign_ideas_launch instead. Add recipients with campaigns_add_recipients, then turn it on with campaigns_set_status.

dailySendingLimit.description: Emails a day at most; null for none

poolId.description: Sender pool to send from; by default the pool with the most inboxes, else Shared Inboxes

steps.description: The first email and its follow-ups, in order

body.description: Links are allowed, and the editor warns about them. Leave out a link to the sender's own site or a booking page: a free trial or test drive is offered in words ("five free reports on our test drive"), and the link goes out once the recipient replies. Naming the recipient's own site ("I was on smilecare.com earlier") is fine.
